name: Char It
description: Scorch an adjacent foe for big fire damage.

name: Stand Near the Meat
description: Everything is under control. Regenerate HP for a while.

name: Improvised Solution
description: 60% great, 35% worse, 5% structural. Outcome unknown.

name: Good Enough
description: Patch yourself up. +10 HP. Close enough.

name: Turn It Off and On Again
description: Stun an adjacent foe. Works on everything but printers.

name: Mandatory Firmware Update
description: All enemies pause for an update they did not request.

name: One More Rep
description: +3 ATK. Health is a mindset.

name: Scoop of Pre-Workout
description: +8 HP and a tingling face.

name: Dad Scan
description: Reveal the whole floor and every foe's health.

name: Tactical Flashlight
description: Blind adjacent foes. And yourself a little.

name: Back In My Day
classes: grill, diy, tech, gym, tactical, sports, yard
description: Nostalgia damage to all nearby. Effects increase yearly.

name: Assume Tactical Stance
description: +2 DEF. You saw this coming.

name: Sideline Tirade
description: Question the officiating at a volume that stuns an adjacent foe. The call does not change. They never do.

name: Halftime Orange Slices
description: Citrus, quartered, distributed at the half. Regenerate HP for a while.

name: Mow It Down
description: The mower meets an adjacent foe. Two-cycle justice. Bag sold separately.

name: Activate The Sprinklers
description: The in-ground system engages on schedule. Everything nearby stops to get out of water it did not expect.

name: The Dad Sneeze
classes: grill, diy, tech, gym, tactical, sports, yard
description: An involuntary, full-body detonation that launches an adjacent foe backward. No warning. No apology. No encore. Bless you.

name: The Nod
description: +2 DEF. A single downward head movement communicating respect, acknowledgment, and quiet authority. No words. They were not needed.

name: Walk It Off
description: +12 HP. He has been walking it off since 1987. It has never once not eventually worked.

name: The Disappointed Look
description: A look that has silenced rooms, ended arguments, and once stopped a ceiling fan mid-spin. Stuns an adjacent foe for 3 turns.

name: Firm Handshake
description: He learned it from his father. His father learned it from his. The lineage delivers 8 damage and expects eye contact.

name: I Watched A Video
description: He watched a video. A whole one. It may or may not apply. Outcome: unpredictable. Confidence: maximum.

name: I'll Fix It Later
description: +6 HP. A temporary measure. He is aware it is temporary. This awareness has not changed the approach.

name: Dad Joke (Deployed)
description: He tells it. The whole floor hears it. The groan travels 3 tiles and deals 5 damage to all nearby enemies. The joke was poor. The damage is real.

name: It's Fine
description: Everything is fine. He is regenerating HP. This is fine. It is all fine. The situation is fine and he is fine.

name: Count Heads
description: He counts. Then counts again. Then counts the exits, the threats, and the ceiling tiles. Everything on this floor: revealed.

name: Found A Shortcut
description: This is not a shortcut. It has never been a shortcut. The announcement of it has confused all nearby enemies for 2 turns while they process the claim.
